package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

// scenario for tests_couple_to_gorm_model_for_api_contract_assertions: API tests that assert persistence model shapes instead of response contracts.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type GormUser struct {
	ID        int    `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
	Name      string `gorm:"size:256" json:"name"`
	Password  string `gorm:"-" json:"-"`
	DeletedAt *int64 `gorm:"index" json:"-"`
}

func TestGetUserByID(t *testing.T) {
	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(GormUser{ID: 1, Name: "Alice"})
	}))
	defer srv.Close()

	resp, _ := http.Get(srv.URL + "/users/1")
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	var got GormUser
	_ = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&got)

	if got.ID != 1 || got.Name != "Alice" {
		t.Errorf("unexpected user: %+v", got)
	}
}
